no_op_tool.description: Does nothing, useful for default plans.

simulate_edit_function_code.description: Simulates editing source code. Inputs: module_path (str), function_name (str), new_code_block (str).

parameters.name: question_text

parameters.name: options

get_project_file_content.description: Reads the content of a specified file within a project.

list_project_files.description: Lists files and directories within a specified project's root path or a subdirectory thereof.

get_item_details_by_id.description: Retrieves details for a specific system item (task, suggestion, or project) using its ID and type.

schema_details.name: get_item_details_by_id
schema_details.description: Retrieves details for a specific system item (task, suggestion, or project) using its ID and type.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the item.

parameters.name: item_type

get_system_status_summary.description: Provides a summary of current system activity, including active/archived tasks and recent unread notifications.

schema_details.name: get_system_status_summary
schema_details.description: Provides a summary of current system activity, including active/archived tasks and recent unread notifications.

parameters.name: active_limit
parameters.description: Optional. Max active tasks to detail (default 5).

parameters.name: archived_limit
parameters.description: Optional. Max archived tasks to detail (default 3).

parameters.name: unread_notifications_limit
parameters.description: Optional. Max unread notifications to detail (default 3).

list_formatted_suggestions.description: Lists system-generated or user-added suggestions, optionally filtered by status (e.g., pending, approved). Useful for reviewing items that might lead to agent improvements or new tasks.

schema_details.name: list_formatted_suggestions
schema_details.description: Lists system-generated or user-added suggestions, optionally filtered by status (e.g., pending, approved). Useful for reviewing items that might lead to agent improvements or new tasks.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Optional. Filter suggestions by status (e.g., 'pending', 'approved', 'implemented', 'denied'). If 'all' or not provided, lists pending suggestions by default. Use 'all' to see all suggestions regardless of status.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries, each representing a suggestion with its key details (id, type, description, status, created_at). Returns an empty list if no suggestions match.

execute_project_plan.description: Executes a structured project plan, step by step. Currently simulates execution for most step types.

schema_details.name: execute_project_plan
schema_details.description: Executes a structured project plan, step by step. Currently simulates execution for most step types.

parameters.name: project_plan
parameters.description: A list of steps, where each step is a dictionary.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this step achieves.

details.description: Dictionary containing type-specific details for the step.

script_content.description: The Python script content as a string.

input_files.description: Optional. Filename:content map for files to create in the execution dir. Keys are filenames (str), values are file content (str).

output_files_to_capture.description: Optional. List of filenames (str) expected to be created, whose content will be captured.

prompt_to_user.description: The question or information to present to the user for review/approval.

message.description: The informational message to log or display.

parameters.name: project_name
parameters.description: Optional. The name or ID of the project this plan relates to.

returns.description: A dictionary summarizing the execution, including overall status, number of steps processed, and results for each step, plus a log preview.

execute_sandboxed_python_script.description: Executes a given Python script string in a temporary, somewhat isolated environment. WARNING: Basic PoC sandbox with minimal security. Use with extreme caution.

schema_details.name: execute_sandboxed_python_script
schema_details.description: Executes a given Python script string in a temporary, somewhat isolated environment. WARNING: Basic PoC sandbox with minimal security. Use with extreme caution.

parameters.name: script_content
parameters.description: The Python script content as a string.

parameters.name: input_files
parameters.description: Optional. Filename:content map for files to create in the execution dir.

parameters.name: output_filenames
parameters.description: Optional. List of filenames expected to be created by the script, whose content will be returned.

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Optional. Timeout for script execution (default 10s).

parameters.name: python_executable
parameters.description: Optional. Path to python interpreter (e.g., 'python' or '/usr/bin/python3'). Defaults to 'python'.

manage_suggestion_status.description: Approves or denies a specific suggestion by its ID.

find_agent_tool_source.description: Finds an existing agent tool's source code, module path, and file path. Searches in standard agent tool directories.

schema_details.name: find_agent_tool_source
schema_details.description: Finds an existing agent tool's source code, module path, and file path. Searches in standard agent tool directories.
parameters: The name of the agent tool to find (e.g., 'my_calculator').
returns: A JSON string representing a dictionary with keys 'module_path', 'function_name', 'file_path', 'source_code', or null if not found.

stage_agent_tool_modification.description: Stages the parameters needed to propose a modification to an existing agent tool. This prepares the information for the self-modification review and application process, typically for ActionExecutor.

schema_details.name: stage_agent_tool_modification
schema_details.description: Stages the parameters needed to propose a modification to an existing agent tool. This prepares the information for the self-modification review and application process, typically for ActionExecutor.
parameters: The module path of the tool (e.g., 'ai_assistant.custom_tools.my_tool').
The function name of the tool to modify.
The complete new source code for the modified function.
Detailed description of the changes made or the reason for modification.
Optional. The ID of the reflection entry that suggested this modification.
Optional. The 'tool_name' for logging/display in ActionExecutor, defaults to function_name.
returns: A JSON string representing a dictionary containing 'action_type_for_executor': 'PROPOSE_TOOL_MODIFICATION' and 'action_details_for_executor': {details_dict}.

get_text_file_snippet.description: Reads and returns a specific snippet of text from a file. Useful for examining a portion of a file before making targeted modifications. Specify the snippet by line numbers, or by start and end patterns, or by a start pattern with surrounding context lines. Line numbers take precedence if provided.

schema_details.name: get_text_file_snippet
schema_details.description: Reads and returns a specific snippet of text from a file. Useful for examining a portion of a file before making targeted modifications. Specify the snippet by line numbers, or by start and end patterns, or by a start pattern with surrounding context lines. Line numbers take precedence if provided.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: The path to the file.

parameters.name: line_range
parameters.description: Optional. A tuple (start_line, end_line) (1-indexed, inclusive) to get specific lines. Takes precedence over patterns.

parameters.name: start_pattern
parameters.description: Optional. A string pattern marking the beginning of the snippet. Used if line_range is not given.

parameters.name: end_pattern
parameters.description: Optional. A string pattern marking the end of the snippet (exclusive of the line containing end_pattern). Used if start_pattern is given.

parameters.name: context_lines_around_pattern
parameters.description: Optional. If only start_pattern is given (and not end_pattern or line_range), this many lines of context will be included before and after the line containing the start_pattern. Default is 5.

returns.description: The extracted text snippet, or an error message if the operation fails (e.g., file not found, pattern not found, invalid range).

get_tools_in_module.description: Returns a list of tool functions and their schemas from this module.

replace_text_in_file.description: Replaces occurrences of a search pattern with replacement text in a specified file. This tool directly modifies the file on disk.

schema_details.name: replace_text_in_file
schema_details.description: Replaces occurrences of a search pattern with replacement text in a specified file. This tool directly modifies the file on disk.

parameters.name: filepath
parameters.description: The path to the file to be modified.

parameters.name: search_pattern
parameters.description: The text string or regular expression pattern to search for.

parameters.name: replacement_text
parameters.description: The text that will replace the found search_pattern.

parameters.name: Nth_occurrence
parameters.description: Optional. Specifies which occurrences to replace. Use 1 for the first match (default), or -1 for all matches. Specific Nth > 1 is not robustly supported for all cases yet.

parameters.name: is_regex
parameters.description: Optional. If True, the search_pattern is treated as a regular expression. Default is False.

returns.description: A message indicating success ('Text replaced and file saved.' or 'Pattern not found, no changes made.') or an error message.

display_html_content_in_project_area.description: Use this tool to render HTML content directly within the main Project Display Area of the user interface. This is for displaying rich content, web pages, or interactive elements, not for chat messages.

schema_details.name: display_html_content_in_project_area
schema_details.description: Use this tool to render HTML content directly within the main Project Display Area of the user interface. This is for displaying rich content, web pages, or interactive elements, not for chat messages.

parameters.name: html_content
parameters.description: The raw HTML string to be rendered in the project display area.

returns.description: A dictionary confirming the action, containing the HTML content. The UI will handle rendering.

modify_displayed_html_content.description: Use this tool to request a targeted modification (search and replace) of the HTML, CSS, or JavaScript content currently shown in the Project Display Area. This is for small, specific changes. Provide a pattern to search for and the code to replace it with. The AI should refer to the 'Currently Displayed Project Code' context to formulate the search_pattern accurately.

schema_details.name: modify_displayed_html_content
schema_details.description: Use this tool to request a targeted modification (search and replace) of the HTML, CSS, or JavaScript content currently shown in the Project Display Area. This is for small, specific changes. Provide a pattern to search for and the code to replace it with. The AI should refer to the 'Currently Displayed Project Code' context to formulate the search_pattern accurately.

parameters.name: search_pattern
parameters.description: The exact string or a unique snippet of the code in the current display that needs to be found and replaced.

parameters.name: replacement_code
parameters.description: The new code snippet that will replace the text matched by search_pattern.

parameters.name: occurrence_index
parameters.description: Optional. Specifies which occurrence to replace if the search_pattern matches multiple times. Default is 0 (the first one).

returns.description: A dictionary representing the modification request for the orchestrator to process.
